data.name: Final Third
data.detailed_description:
Final Third is a physics-driven football (soccer) game for up to 4v4.

The ball is an independent physics object - it never sticks to your feet. No goalkeepers, no fixed positions, and no two matches the same. Oh, and the aliens are watching!

CONTROL EVERY TOUCH

Trapping is an input, not a state. So is shielding, turning, and every pass you thread. Nothing is automatic - a good first touch is earned, not handed to you.


Take to the field and let your skills flow. Whether you’re slipping past tackles, breaking through defenses, or dribbling through the midfield, every touch is yours.

EACH PLAYER COUNTS

Up to 4v4, with no fixed positions and no assigned defenders.

Team up with other players in fast, pick-up soccer where every moment shapes the flow of the game. There are no fixed roles in Final Third, so everyone can create space, press attacks and build chances together.

Individuals inspire wins, teams earn them.

THE GOAL BELONGS TO THE TEAM

In Final Third, there’s no goalkeeper, just you, your teammates, and the moment you create together.

Goals are protected by walls that respond to power, precision, and pressure, turning every shot into a chance to shift the rhythm of the match.

When the wall shakes, the box comes alive. Loose balls, rebounds, second touches, these are the moments where instinct meets teamwork, and where matches are won.

Read the chaos, crash the space, and fight for the final touch.

In Final Third, goals aren’t saved or conceded, they’re earned.

REINVENT EVERY MATCH

Bring up to 12 Perks into a match. At every trigger - kickoff, each minute, every goal - three are offered at random from your set. They reset when the match ends.

No build carries over. What you bring is a loadout; what you do with it is the match.

A SOCIAL EXPERIENCE

The Hub is your space to unwind, run around, watch ongoing matches, join spontaneous pickup games, or just hang out with other players.

It’s the spirit of real pickup soccer, brought to life in a new way.

TO RULE THE FIELD

An ultra-advanced alien race has mastered everything except soccer.
Too many legs, no control, so they abduct humans as test subjects to learn the game.

They bring the tech.
You bring the legs.
Show them how it’s actually done.


QUICK FACTS

• Up to 4v4 online PvP football (soccer)

• No goalkeepers · No fixed positions

• Physics-driven ball - every touch is an input

• Up to 12 Perks, reshuffled every match

• Cross-play supported - PC first, console to follow

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
